_comment: Illustrative merge fragment. OpenClaw does NOT define an ${OPENCLAW_PLUGIN_ROOT} variable, so the args path below will NOT expand: replace /abs/path/to/openclaw-plugin with the real absolute path to this package, and /abs/path/to/node with the output of `command -v node` in a terminal (the gateway may not start with your shell's PATH, so a bare node can fail to start), before merging into ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json, or run `openclaw remembrance setup` (see README).
